investment_strategy: Aim to capture the AI-driven productivity and capex supercycle while respecting elevated near-term volatility (VIX ~23) and tighter financial conditions (10Y ~4.3%). Concentrate on cash-rich, dominant AI platforms (MSFT, GOOGL) with durable earnings power and positive analyst support, complemented by a measured exposure to the core semiconductor enabler (NVDA). Size risk to favor lower-volatility platforms and limit high-beta exposure. Execution: deploy now with quarterly rebalancing; trim/add around catalysts (earnings, regulatory outcomes, export-control updates). Risk controls: cap single-stock drawdown reviews at -20%; if VIX > 30, reduce NVDA by 3-5% and shift to MSFT; monitor antitrust (GOOGL) and China export risks (NVDA). Time horizon: 12-36 months.

portfolio_summary.strategy_focus: Overweight cash-rich AI platforms with strong earnings power and add a measured semiconductor enabler to participate in the AI capex cycle while managing macro and regulatory risks.

analysis_summary.selection_criteria: Prioritized lower volatility with strong earnings/revenue growth, positive analyst consensus, and solid ROE; considered momentum and trend; sized positions to macro (VIX ~23, 10Y ~4.3%) and thematic fit (AI platforms + semis). Excluded AAPL (slower momentum, bearish trend, higher multiple) and META (higher vol, uneven recent growth) at this time.
analysis_summary.market_outlook: Constructive multi-year AI adoption and monetization across software/platforms with a massive supporting capex cycle in compute and power; near-term volatility expected given rate backdrop, regulatory actions, and export controls. Favor dominant, cash-rich platforms and core semiconductor enablers while actively managing position sizes and headline risk.
